title: Trouble waking up
content: Do any of u have trouble waking up until your dream is over? It’s not sleep paralysis or lucid dreaming. I’m not aware I’m dreaming or waiting to wake up. It’s more I sleep for 16 hours untill the dream has fixed the problem I’m currently going through in mall world. I could go to bed at 8 pm and not wake up till 11 am or longer the next day because that’s how long the dream took. I can wake up in between and try to get up but I won’t be able to cause the dream is still continuing. Once my dream is resolved I wake up very suddenly and have trouble remembering what the dream even was Main point is I’m not having sleep paralysis but if I wake up I can move and stuff but my body physically can not get up out of bed even tho I can move fine and I have to sleep more even if I have had a full night of sleep to finishe my dream. Even when their scary and I don’t wnat to continue them. Again not sleep paralysis
